criteria.rationale: Provider and exact displayed model were bound for one authorized ChatGPT catalog run; no reusable provider or model approval exists.
The bounded synthetic data flow and raw-response deletion were accepted for one run. Reusable retention approval and Zero Data Retention remain unconfirmed.
A bounded run over the two registered requirements-only pilot sources completed provider projection, adaptation and authoritative validation end to end.
The provider did not receive expected outcomes; all three versioned synthetic catalog cases passed with one required detection and no prohibited detections.
The maintainer classified the exact synthetic finding as helpful while withholding normative resolution.
One required and two prohibited synthetic outcomes were evaluated. The catalog is too small and contains no approved real-source ground truth for general quality claims.
The run, deterministic validation and human triage were completed, but structured effort duration and provider cost were not captured; ChatGPT subscription cost attribution was unavailable.
The pilot scopes are explicit, but the intended production document population is not registered, authorized and approved for semantic review.
The bounded semantic reports do not assess repository or consumer implementation coverage.
The successful catalog run is not wired into the public viewer, scheduled execution or blocking enforcement, and no such rollout is authorized.

open_requirements: Approve a reusable provider, exact model policy, data flow and retention profile.
Register and authorize the intended production source population.
Expand approved ground truth to measure known misses and false positives beyond three synthetic cases.
Capture structured execution time, human triage effort and attributable provider cost.
Assess implementation coverage separately from document consistency.
Authorize and design publication, scheduling or blocking enforcement separately if desired.
